author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell's guest describes a deeply personal moment kneeling before the Shroud of Turin, and makes a striking claim, that it's not just a relic but what he calls an itemized receipt of how much Jesus loves us. He connects it to the story of Lazarus, arguing Jesus's body itself changed after the resurrection, gaining new capabilities that let it pass through the shroud entirely rather than simply shedding it like grave clothes. His boldest claim comes at the end, that every piece of evidence for Christ's resurrection is also evidence for our own, calling it a kind of new creation, almost like a second Big Bang. A genuinely fascinating conversation for anyone curious about the shroud and what it might actually mean.
